function.name: get_dds_format

parameters.description: Pointer to a DDS_PIXELFORMAT structure that contains the pixel format to be matched.

function.return_type: struct dds_format *; Represents a pointer to a 'dds_format' structure in the 'dds_format_table' that matches the given 'pixel_format'. If no match is found, it points to the last element in the 'dds_format_table'.
